entry.title: New: Bill 122 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Postponed
entry.content:
AMENDS CHAPTER 25 AND CHAPTER 14, ARTICLE 4, SECTION 14-20, (Draft 2) OF THE HAWAIʻI COUNTY CODE 1983 (2016 EDITION, AS AMENDED), RELATING TO THE REPEAL OF BED AND BREAKFAST AS A PERMITTED USE

Repeals all provisions that allow for Bed and Breakfast establishments.

Latest action: PCPLUD Postponed to the Call of the Chair - 11/08/24; never taken up again
